description.en: Plays (or stops) an NPC's talking idle motion during a conversation started with CMND_TALK_START.
Handle of the NPC being talked to.
True to play the talking motion.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Play the NPC's talking motion while the conversation is open
CMND_SET_TALK_MOTION(npcHdl, true);
